title: crataegus lassa var. recurva
intro: Crataegus lassa var. recurva, commonly known as a variety of the hawthorn plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure and cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and lowering the risk of heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus lassa var. recurva are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for human consumption.
